PolyAI Platform · Documentation

## [​](https://docs.poly.ai/home\#from-first-draft-to-production)  From first draft to production.

PolyAI is the Agentic Dialog Platform for voice and chat agents that complete
real customer tasks — bookings, payments, claims, escalations — across 24+
languages, at sub-300ms latency. Built for resolution, not deflection.

[Start the quickstart](https://docs.poly.ai/get-started/quickstart) [Platform overview →](https://docs.poly.ai/platform/introduction)

## [​](https://docs.poly.ai/home\#how-a-polyai-agent-works)  How a PolyAI agent works

Every agent handles a conversation the same way: it listens, decides what to do from your configuration and knowledge, then responds — in under 300ms, in 24+ languages. [Raven](https://docs.poly.ai/behavior/models/raven), our voice-native model, drives each turn.You shape that behavior across four areas:

- **Behavior** — the agent’s personality, rules, and [guardrails](https://docs.poly.ai/behavior/guardrails/introduction).
- **Knowledge** — grounded [FAQs and sources](https://docs.poly.ai/knowledge/faqs/introduction) so answers stay accurate, not hallucinated.
- **Flows** — [multi-step logic](https://docs.poly.ai/flows/introduction) for tasks like booking, payment, or verification.
- **Voice** — natural [text-to-speech](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/introduction) tuned for real phone conversations.

Every change lands in [Sandbox](https://docs.poly.ai/environments-and-versions/environments) before it reaches Live. An optional Staging environment lets you try the agent on a real call before your customers do.

## [​](https://docs.poly.ai/home\#choose-how-you-build)  Choose how you build

The same agent is available through three surfaces. Start in whichever fits how you work — and mix them at any time.

[**Agent Studio** \\
\\
**No-code & low-code.** Configure behavior, knowledge, voice, and flows visually in the browser.](https://docs.poly.ai/get-started/introduction)

[**ADK** \\
\\
**Code & Git.** Pull your agent into local YAML and Python, edit in your IDE, and ship from the CLI.](https://docs.poly.ai/adk)

[**REST APIs** \\
\\
**Programmatic.** Build, run, and observe agents from your own systems — no SDK required.](https://docs.poly.ai/api-reference/introduction)

Prefer code? Use the ADK

\# needs uv + Python 3.14

$pip install polyai-adk

$poly start\# new account, key & first agent

\# edit flows, topics, and functions locally

$poly push\# ship your changes to Agent Studio

[Explore the ADK →](https://docs.poly.ai/adk)

**New — Wren.** Describe your agent in natural language and let it draft the first version for you. [Get started](https://docs.poly.ai/wren/introduction).

## [​](https://docs.poly.ai/home\#what-you-can-build)  What you can build

PolyAI agents run in production for banks, hotels, healthcare providers, and retailers — handling the calls and chats that used to need a person:

- **Bookings & reservations** — check availability, take a reservation, modify or cancel.
- **Payments** — take secure payments and process refunds mid-conversation.
- **Claims & servicing** — file a claim, check a balance, update an account.
- **Escalations** — resolve what it can, then [hand off](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/handoffs) to a human with full context.
